origins.name: Accelerated Assault
origins.description: Dealing sustained damage with this weapon loads a small amount of ammo from reserves, or removes heat, and slightly increases damage.

origins.name: Problem Solver
origins.description:
Dealing sustained damage to Champion, miniboss, or boss combatants exhausts them and grants this weapon handling and reload speed.

Exhausted targets deal reduced outgoing damage.

origins.name: Vanguard Determination
origins.description: After using your class ability, final blows with this weapon grant you bonus damage resistance.

perks.name: Feeding Frenzy
perks.description: Each rapid kill with this weapon progressively increases reload speed for a short time.

enhanced.description: Each rapid final blow with this weapon progressively increases reload speed substantially for a short time.

perks.description: This weapon slowly reloads itself over time, up to double capacity.

enhanced.name: Reconstruction
enhanced.description: This weapon reloads itself at an improved rate over time, up to double capacity.

perks.name: Envious Arsenal
perks.description: Dealing damage with both other weapons before readying this weapon refills it from reserves.

enhanced.name: Envious Arsenal
enhanced.description: Dealing damage with both other weapons before readying this weapon refills it from reserves. Increases ammo generation.

perks.name: Successful Warm-Up
perks.description: Each final blow increases charge/draw speed.

enhanced.name: Successful Warm-Up
enhanced.description: Each final blow increases charge/draw speed for an improved duration.

enhanced.name: Reservoir Burst

perks.name: High-Impact Reserves
